Auth.OidcIncomplete: Keycloak sign-in was not completed. Please try again.
Auth.StatusCheckFailed: Unable to check your sign-in status. Please try again.
Auth.DevelopmentLoginDisabled: Development login is disabled on this backend.
Auth.SignInFailed: Unable to sign in. Check the server connection and try again.

Dashboard.Title: Dashboard
Dashboard.Description: Your tax records and next steps, all in one place.
Dashboard.IncomeExpensesForYear: Income and expenses from transactions recorded for
Dashboard.ChooseYear: Choose a year from the sidebar to see its financial trends.
Dashboard.NoTransactions: No transactions recorded for this financial year yet.
Dashboard.NoReviewItems: No review items for this financial year.
Dashboard.ReviewConfirm: Review and confirm extracted tax information.
Dashboard.NewReviewItems: New items needing your review will appear here.
Dashboard.UploadReceipts: Upload receipts and statements to keep your evidence together.

Documents.Title: Documents
Documents.Description: All your tax documents in one place.
Documents.ProcessingStatus: Processing and review statuses update automatically every 5 seconds.
Documents.NoForYear: No documents for this financial year
Documents.TryDifferentFilters: Try removing a filter or searching with different keywords.
Documents.ChooseAnotherYear: Choose another year or upload a receipt or tax document.
Documents.UploadToList: Upload a receipt or tax document to see it listed here.

Assets.Title: Assets
Assets.Description: Property and investment details are maintained across years. The financial-year selector filters documents, transactions and reviews, and the rental summary on each property.
Assets.AddAustralianProperty: Add an Australian property to your records.
Assets.MainResidence: I live here (main residence). Its costs and loan interest are kept out of the accountant pack.
Assets.PropertyEmptyDescription: Record property details to keep rental and ownership evidence together.
Assets.MainResidenceShort: Main residence · not on tax return
Assets.PropertyLookup: Look it up on property.com.au, then enter it with Edit.
Assets.RecordInvestment: Record an acquisition or investment position.
Assets.InvestmentEmptyDescription: Add shares, funds, or other investments to organise acquisition and disposal details.

Transactions.Title: Income & expenses
Transactions.Description: Record and review the transactions that support your tax position.
Transactions.FinancialYearAssignment: Records are assigned to a financial year using the transaction date.
Transactions.EmptyDescription: Add income and expenses manually. Bank imports and receipt matching are planned follow-up features.
Transactions.ImportDescription: Upload a CSV or OFX export from your bank's online banking. Review the rows, then import. Re-importing the same file will not create duplicates. Nothing is sent to a third party.
Transactions.SuggestedHint: Suggested tax return items are only hints based on the description. Check them before importing.
Transactions.WfhDescription: Record the hours you worked from home each day. Hours × the per-hour rate gives the fixed-rate claim your accountant can use. Keep timesheets, rosters or a diary as proof.
Transactions.SelectYearForWfh: Select a financial year in the header to log working-from-home hours.
Transactions.DefaultRateHint: Default rate shown. Confirm the current ATO rate for this year with your accountant.
Transactions.ReplaceExisting: Entering a date that already has hours replaces them.
Transactions.NoDays: No days logged for this year yet.

Reviews.Title: Review queue
Reviews.Description: Check extracted details and resolve items that need your attention.
Reviews.RefreshStatus: Review statuses update automatically every 5 seconds.
Reviews.FilterBy: Filter by status or review type
Reviews.ChangeFilters: Try changing or clearing your filters to see other reviews.
Reviews.NoWaiting: There are no items waiting in your review queue right now.

TaxReturn.Title: Accountant pack
TaxReturn.Description: Hand your accountant a complete, verifiable evidence package for the financial year: reviewed records, source documents and a transaction ledger.
TaxReturn.PackageDescription: TaxVault packages the records and evidence associated with the selected Australian financial year.
TaxReturn.AddYearFirst: Add a financial year before generating an export.
TaxReturn.YearHint: To pack a different year, change the Financial year selector at the top of the page.
TaxReturn.Evidence: Tax evidence, provenance, and classification records
TaxReturn.Integrity: Data integrity hash for the generated snapshot
TaxReturn.Disclaimer: TaxVault organises evidence for your accountant. It does not prepare or lodge tax returns and does not give tax advice.

Upload.Title: Upload documents
Upload.Description: Add receipts or tax documents to TaxVault.
Upload.NoYearNotice: No financial year exists yet. You can still upload; after local text extraction, TaxVault will suggest a year from the document date and ask before creating it.
Upload.NoTypesNotice: No active document types are available. Ask an administrator to enable document types before uploading.
Upload.BulkDescription: Drag and drop multiple files, choose files, or select a folder. Each file will use the financial year and document type selected above.
Upload.FileTypes: PDF, JPG, PNG, WEBP, or TIFF · Maximum 20 MB per file
Upload.DuplicateNotice: TaxVault kept the previously uploaded document. Review the matching document in your document list.
Upload.UploadNotice: Files are uploaded one at a time. Each will be stored securely and queued for local text extraction and review.
Upload.EmailDescription: Send or forward emails with PDF or image attachments to your private address. They appear in Documents for review.

Accountants.Title: Manage accountants
Accountants.Description: Give your accountant read-only access, or email them your Accountant pack.
Accountants.ShownOnce: Shown only once. Share it securely; they must change it at first sign-in.
Accountants.Name: Name

FinancialYears.Title: Financial years
FinancialYears.Description: Manage the Australian financial years used to organise your tax records.
FinancialYears.FormHint: Use the format YYYY - YY. Tax years run from 1 July to 30 June. The year can only change while it has no records.
FinancialYears.EmptyDescription: Add a financial year to start uploading tax documents and recording transactions.

Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.Description: Your profile and how TaxVault works for you. Preferences are saved to your account.
Settings.Name: Name
Settings.ProfileHint: Your name and email come from your sign-in account and are managed there.
Settings.FinancialYearOnSignIn: Financial year when you sign in
Settings.GeneralHint: You can still change the financial year at any time from the header.
Settings.NotificationsHint: Choose what appears under the bell in the header.
Settings.DocumentsNotificationHint: Documents that need review, failed processing or need a financial year.
Settings.UncategorisedTransactionsHint: Transactions without a tax return item.
Settings.EmailRemindersHint: Optional emails to your sign-in address. Each email has an unsubscribe link.
Settings.WeeklyReviewDigestHint: At most one email a week when documents need your review.
Settings.DeadlineRemindersHint: 30 days, 7 days and 1 day before the deadline.
Settings.DeadlineHint: Without a date we use 31 October after each financial year ends. Please confirm your actual date with the ATO or a tax agent.
Settings.AccessHint: Invite your accountant to view your records, or remove their access.
